QueryParamDict inherits from the fixed urlutils class, and FastIterOrderedMultiDict inherits from the fixed dictutils class. The change is one line in each source file, plus regression tests in tests/ with no new dependencies. I did not run anything, so this rests on reading the diff. I also did not open the source files, so I'm assuming neither class overrides addlist. I'm going from memory of upstream boltons, where neither does.
